change: The manual harmonic-response controls, public method review and reproducible report are added to distinguish algebra evidence from unperformed native accuracy and convergence checks.
Scratch becomes optional for in-memory calculations; palette decoding, report controls and deferred method observations are clarified without extending native qualification.

Report controls exercise the Windows symlink privilege error and require a UTF-8 palette read with a rendered palette definition, so unavailable symlinks and omitted styling are detected without extending native qualification.
